description: Flat-sided slip-on drilling fixture with reusable height spacers, a positive tube-end datum and replaceable purchased guide elements.
releaseRequirements: Measure actual tube OD, roundness and wall thickness. Qualify fit and seating against the annular stop.
Measure actual spacer thickness and face parallelism. Verify fixed drill height minus the measured spacer stack equals the desired tube-end offset.
Verify all hardware stays behind the support flats before placing the fixture on a flat table or in a vise.
Verify guide procurement, free drill passage, guide retention, printed screw engagement and station clearance.
Clamp tube and jig against rotation and lift. Set drilling depth for one wall; remove the jig before tapping.
Specify print material, orientation, fit allowances, drawing tolerances and inspection before manufacture.
